summary.name: Bugasura
summary.one_liner: Bugasura is a bug tracker and quality platform with AI "Asura" testing agents, test management, and integrations for software teams.
use_cases: Tracking and closing software bugs across a development team
Running end-to-end browser and mobile tests with AI agents
Validating API contracts and error states in CI
Giving AI coding agents quality context via MCP
Getting leadership visibility into quality risk
summary.what_it_does: Bugasura is a bug tracker for reporting, tracking and closing bugs, extended with a set of AI quality agents called Asuras. The Browser and Mobile Asuras run end-to-end tests that navigate, click, assert and report, and the API Asura validates API contracts and escalates failures to Bugasura issues. The Duplicate Asura monitors incoming bug reports and flags duplicates, with Slack notifications. The page also describes an MCP server that connects Bugasura to Claude and Cursor, and an Eagle Eye view aimed at engineering leaders. It lists 25+ integrations.
notable: Specialized AI Asura agents for browser, mobile, API and duplicate-bug testing
MCP server connecting Bugasura quality context to Claude and Cursor
Data hosted in India and Singapore, SOC 2 Type II certified, SSO/SAML, on-prem option
Free forever tier with unlimited users per page claims
caveats: Page says 'free forever' but does not detail limits of the free tier
Testimonials and customer counts are self-reported marketing claims
Specific Asura pricing and on-prem terms are not stated on the page
